SessionToken.description: Passkey session token issued by POST /api/auth/passkey/complete or the device-link/handoff flows - what the browser/native app clients use.
SessionToken.name: X-Session-Token

ApiKey.description: Long-lived per-user API key (generated on the Setup page, one slot each for Home Assistant/AI/MCP/Capture - see ApiKeyScopes). Scoped per slot to a subset of endpoints; an out-of-scope request answers 403, not 401.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
